text:
Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
8:23 PM

A relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with one main sight in the morning, a long lunch break and an easy evening each day.

Day 1, Amber Fort and the old city: Amber Fort early, before the crowds and heat, with a jeep up to the gate so there's less climbing. Stop at Jal Mahal for photos, then see Hawa Mahal and stroll Johari Bazaar in the evening.
Day 2, palaces and culture: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning, then lunch and a rest at the hotel. Visit Albert Hall Museum around sunset when it's lit up, and have dinner with a Rajasthani thali and folk show at Chokhi Dhani.
Day 3, slow morning and shopping: Nahargarh Fort for the city view, then Birla Mandir. Spend the afternoon at Bapu Bazaar for block prints, jootis and sweets before heading home.

A hotel near the old city or C-Scheme with a lift and an in-house car keeps things comfortable. When are they travelling, and from which city? I can adjust the plan and timings.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
8:27 PM

The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi: open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM; closed Mondays and national holidays. Entry: adults ₹20 foreign nationals ₹500 students up to class 12 free with ID card. Note: the site's last gallery notice (29 May 2023) says Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries were closed for renovation until further notice.
